name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Could an American win men's singles at this year's U.S. Open?
changes.summary: The Athletic's Lukas Weese joins CBS News to discuss who has the best chances with the U.S. Open tennis tournament underway in New York City.

changes.title: Daily fragment: TWA Flight 529
changes.summary: TWA Flight 529 crashed shortly after takeoff from Midway Airport in Chicago, killing all 78 people on board. At the time, it was the deadliest single plane disaster in U.S. history.

changes.title: Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll Resigns as U.S. Military Grapples With Two Wars
changes.summary: The resignation of Daniel P. Driscoll, the secretary of the Army, had been expected but comes at a tumultuous time for the service.

changes.title: How the Pentagon Is Getting Into the Venezuelan Oil Business Under Trump
changes.summary: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.

changes.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal will rely on North American Blue Energy Partners
changes.summary: The Trump administration's plan to take a stake in tens of billions of barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves will hinge on a private company called North American Blue Energy Partners, the White House announced Monday.

changes.title: China or the U.S.? Two Meetings Offer Competing Showcases of Global Power.
changes.summary: As Xi Jinping gathered with the leaders of Russia and Iran, Europe challenged the Trump administration at the G20, offering a split-screen view of a changing world.

changes.title: U.S. Sanctions on Iran Cut Off Students From Tests Needed for Study Abroad
changes.summary: The latest measures have forced the cancellation of English proficiency and graduate exams, isolating many Iranians most eager to foster ties with the world.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Chris Pilkerton, assistant secretary for investment security at the U.S. Treasury Department, is at the G20 summit in Asheville, North Carolina, and joins CBS News with more on what to expect.

changes.title: Trump to meet with U.S. oil executives amid Pentagon infighting
changes.summary: President Trump will meet with U.S. oil executives over the price of oil. This comes after Army Secretary Dan Driscoll submitted his resignation following months of friction with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has more.

changes.title: Oil prices rise again as U.S. renews Iran strikes
changes.summary: Energy and gas prices are up again after the U.S. resumed strikes on Iran. CBS News' Kelly O'Grady has more on the economic outlook.
